subject: WillowTech quota window mismatch causing sustained throttles
messages:
From: Jared Klein <jared.klein@willowtech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@willowtech.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors and 5xxs across burst windows

Kimberly,

We started seeing a spike in 503/429 responses from Redwood for our mission-critical inference endpoints starting ~08:55 PT this morning. The pattern looks like short-lived but repeated throttles every minute for ~30s, which is killing real-time flows for our agent-facing product. Latency spikes to 1.5–2s and error rate climbs to ~12% in that window.

Attached: prod-logs-20280420.zip (request/response samples, timestamps).

This started after we increased our burst allowance last week — we expected smoothing, not this. We're on a tight launch timeline; this is blocking user-facing tests. Can someone triage now?

-Jared
Jared Klein
Head of Platform, WillowTech
jared.klein@willowtech.com

Subject: Re: Production errors and 5xxs across burst windows

Thanks for the heads-up, Jared — really sorry you're seeing this. We're treating this as high priority. I'm pulling engineering in now.

Immediate plan:
- Aditya + infra will look at per-tenant rate limiter metrics and burst policy snapshot (we have an internal hypothesis about a window misalignment).
- I'll propose a short mitigation (per-tenant override / temporary increase to dedicated capacity) and schedule a 30-min call if you can join.
- We'll share any quick rollbacks/changes before making them.

Can you confirm the exact launch traffic profile (QPS, typical burst durations) and whether you changed client-side retry/backoff last week? Thanks for the logs — we'll pull them into the ticket.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Production errors and 5xxs across burst windows

Kim / team — preliminary findings from tracing and rate-limiter logs:

- Symptom: short, periodic 5xx/429 clusters aligned to the top of each minute (observed 08:55:00–08:55:30, 08:56:00–08:56:35, etc.).
- Root cause (likely): WillowTech's burst allowance (configured client-side) allows big arrivals at 00s, but our token-bucket refill is on a 60s window for global tenant-level buckets. A recent change to burst handling (merged last week) introduced a per-tenant shard that uses a 10s internal refill but with a window rounding bug. The result: when large bursts arrive exactly at the minute boundary, two mechanisms interact and drop tokens briefly.

Evidence: rate_limiter/tenant/WIL-2345 metrics + snapshot attached (burst_policy_snapshot.png). Also linked INF-7890 where a similar regression was fixed but not applied to the per-tenant override path.

Proposed immediate remediations (short-term):
1) Apply a per-tenant rate-limiter override for WIL-2345 to switch to continuous refill and increase burst cap by 2x for the next 48 hours.
2) If (1) is insufficient, promote WillowTech requests to dedicated pool for the next 12 hours to avoid global window edges.

Longer-term: patch the window rounding logic and add a regression test for minute-boundary bursts. I'll open a hotfix PR and target a canary deploy tonight.

Attachments: burst_policy_snapshot.png

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Rate Limiting
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jared Klein <jared.klein@willowtech.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@willowtech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fast follow: remediation plan and 16:00 PT maintenance window

Jared / Sarah — quick update on next steps from our side:

- We're going to apply a per-tenant continuous-refill override for your account at 16:00 PT today. This is a safe, reversible change and should remove the minute-boundary drops.
- If the errors persist after 16:00, we'll immediately move traffic to a short-lived dedicated pool while Aditya's team pushes the hotfix.
- We'll run a focused regression test during the maintenance window and share results within 30 min of completion.

Can you confirm a 16:00 PT window works for you for a 15-minute maintenance test? If you prefer earlier, tell us and we can try to accelerate.

Thanks — and big apologies for the disruption. We're treating this as an exec-visible outage until resolved.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jared Klein <jared.klein@willowtech.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Production errors and 5xxs across burst windows — verification

Following the per-tenant override and the hotfix deploy (INF-7890 patched), WillowTech's error rate returned to baseline within the maintenance window. Post-change metrics: error rate <0.5%, p95 latency dropped back under 200ms for the period that previously hit ~1.5s.

Action items closed / next steps:
- INF-7890: hotfix merged and scheduled for full rollout (tracking INF-7890).
- Operations: add a canary around minute-boundary bursts for tenant-level tests.
- Customer success: schedule a 1:1 recap w/ WillowTech and provide the logs bundle we used for root-cause analysis.

Jared — please let us know if you want the post-mortem and regression test artifacts; we can share a short executive summary for your launch stakeholders.

Thanks everyone for the rapid work.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
